# Nexus AI Solution
> Autonomous AI Voice Calling & Workflow Automation Agency

## Overview
Nexus AI Solution is an AI agency founded by Pradeep Kumar Dagur (Rajasthan, India). It builds production-ready 24/7 AI voice receptionists (Vapi.ai), event-driven CRM automations (Make.com, n8n), and high-conversion landing pages for clinics, real estate, salons, and SMBs across India, the US, and Europe.

## Services & Packages
- Basic AI Voice Calling Agent: ₹12,000 (3-day delivery)
- AI Calling Agent + Responsive Website: ₹20,000 (5-day delivery)
- Full Enterprise Automation (Voice + Web + WhatsApp CRM): ₹35,000 (7-day delivery)
